description: This file defines a static class 'Dependencies' with a method 'ConfigureServices' that configures dependency injection services for a web application, setting up database contexts with either in-memory or SQL Server based on configuration.

classes.name: Dependencies
classes.description: A static class providing configuration for dependency injection services, primarily setting up Entity Framework Core database contexts.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Configures database contexts for the application, choosing between in-memory and SQL Server based on configuration settings.
